Class TwoCoreIntBased

java.lang.Object
algorithms.TwoCoreIntBased
public class TwoCoreIntBased extends Object
Computes the vertices and edges in the two core of a graph, WITHOUT constructing a new graph. Process: recognize edges incident to degree one vertices, and update vertex degrees. Modified from trubbl-core project so vertices and edges are both of Integer type. This allows passing results back in the form of boolean arrays.

Applicable to SparseIntDirectedWeightedGraph and SparseIntUnirectedWeightedGraph objects. Example

Edge list of random graph: {h, b}, {e, b}, {g, h}, {g, d}, {d, f}, {a, k}, {g, e}, {b, k}, {a, g}, Two core vertices: a, b, e, g, h, k, Two core edges: {h, b}, {b, k}, {a, k}, {g, h}, {g, e}, {e, b}, {a, g}, Numbers of edges removed per round: 1, 1, 0.

Author:
R. W. R. Darling

  • Constructor Details

    • TwoCoreIntBased

      public TwoCoreIntBased(org.jgrapht.graph.AbstractGraph<Integer,Integer> myGraph)
      Creates a 2-core analyzer for an integer-labeled graph.

      The constructor initializes degree tracking and output arrays but does not run the peeling algorithm; call computeTwoCore() to compute results.

      Parameters:
      myGraph - input graph; may include isolated vertices

  • Method Details

    • computeTwoCore

      public void computeTwoCore()
      Computes the 2-core by iterative leaf-edge removal.

      At each round, all edges incident to current degree-1 vertices are removed from the working edge set, degrees are updated, and the process repeats until no such edges remain. The method then populates:

      • twoCoreVertices and twoCoreEdges, and
      • array views vertexIsInTwoCore and edgeIsInTwoCore for fast downstream lookup.

    • getTwoCoreVertices

      public Set<Integer> getTwoCoreVertices()
      Returns the vertices in the computed 2-core.
      Returns:
      set of vertex IDs whose final degree is at least 2 after peeling

    • getTwoCoreEdges

      public Set<Integer> getTwoCoreEdges()
      Returns the edges in the computed 2-core.
      Returns:
      set of edge IDs that remain after iterative leaf-edge removal

    • getCountEdgesRemovedEachRound

      public int[] getCountEdgesRemovedEachRound()
      Returns how many edges are removed at each peeling round.

      Index 0 corresponds to the initial batch of outer edges found before the first update pass.

      Returns:
      array indexed by round number with counts of removed edges

    • twoCoreVertexProportion

      public double twoCoreVertexProportion()
      Returns the fraction of graph vertices that lie in the 2-core.
      Returns:
      |V(2-core)| / |V(graph)|

    • getVertexIsInTwoCore

      public boolean[] getVertexIsInTwoCore()
      Returns a boolean lookup array for 2-core vertex membership.

      Entry i is true iff vertex ID i is in the computed 2-core.

      Returns:
      vertex-membership array indexed by vertex ID

    • getEdgeIsInTwoCore

      Returns a boolean lookup array for 2-core edge membership.

      Returns:
